# LLM Integration & Developer Context Guide (`LLMS.txt`)
## Hydro Industries — Executive Parallax Slide Deck System

This document provides complete architectural context, conventions, state flow, and guidelines for LLMs, AI agents, and developers interacting with or extending this codebase.

---

## 1. Project Synopsis

The project is an executive-tier, discrete-step 3D parallax web presentation system built for **Hydro Industries**. It is deployed for presentations led by the Global CEO and executive leadership team.

### Primary Technologies
- **Vite 6** (`vite.config.ts`)
- **React 19** (`src/App.tsx`, `src/main.tsx`)
- **TypeScript 5.8** (`tsconfig.json` with strict mode, `noEmit`, bundler resolution)
- **Tailwind CSS v4** (`@tailwindcss/vite` plugin with `@theme` block in `src/index.css`)
- **Native HTML5 Canvas** (Custom real-time physics and ray-traced spherical projections)

---

```
.
├── PDR.md                      # Product Design & Architecture Document

├── vite.config.ts              # Vite plugins configuration
├── public/
│   └── media/
│       ├── logo-dark.png       # Transparent vector-crisp dark Hydro logo
│       ├── logo-white.png      # White monochrome Hydro logo for dark themes
│       └── slides/
│           ├── hero-water.png         # High-res caustics water background
│           ├── impact-abstract.png    # 3D metallic fluid wave background
│           ├── quito-plant.png        # Quito landfill leachate treatment plant
│           ├── beeah-plant.png        # BEE'AH Sharjah wastewater reuse plant
│           ├── desalination-light.png # High-key light refraction background
│           └── earth-texture.png      # 2048x1024 Blue Marble Earth satellite texture
└── src/
    ├── App.tsx                 # Discrete navigation controller & gesture event coordinator
    ├── content.ts              # Presentation datasets, copy, metadata, and slide definitions
    ├── index.css               # Tailwind v4 theme, design tokens & stagger animations
    ├── main.tsx                # StrictMode entrypoint & manual scroll restoration
    ├── components/
    │   ├── DeckHud.tsx         # Bottom floating pill controller & slide index drawer
    │   ├── EarthGlobe3D.tsx    # 3D Ray-traced floating Earth globe canvas
    │   ├── ElectroCoagulationSim.tsx # Real-time particle physics electro-coagulation canvas
    │   ├── ParallaxSlide.tsx   # Discrete 3-plane parallax viewport stage container
    │   ├── Slides.tsx          # All 13 configured presentation slide implementations
    │   ├── TreatmentProcessDiagram.tsx # Interactive 5-stage SVG treatment architecture
    │   └── WaterCausticsCanvas.tsx     # Procedural dynamic water caustics overlay
    └── lib/
        ├── math.ts             # Interpolation (lerp, clamp, range, ease curves)
        └── scroll.ts           # Continuous ambient rAF tick subscriber registry
```

---

## 3. Core Technical Conventions

### 3.1 Discrete Presentation State (Not Free Scroll)
- In `App.tsx`, `currentIdx` is the single source of truth for the active slide.
- Navigation transitions are triggered via:
  1. `goTo(idx: number)`
  2. Keyboard events: `ArrowRight`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowUp`, `Space`, `PageDown`, `PageUp`
  3. Discrete wheel events: intercepted with `e.preventDefault()` and locked for $650\text{ms}$ per slide transition.
  4. Touch swipe events: `touchstart` / `touchend` delta tracking with a $45\text{px}$ threshold.
  5. HUD buttons or slide drawer modal selection.

### 3.2 Slide Lifecycle: `stateOf(idx)`
Each `ParallaxSlide` receives a `state` prop:
- `'active'`: The current slide displayed in full view (`z-20`, `opacity-100`, `visible`).
- `'before'`: A previously visited slide positioned above the viewport (`translate3d(0, -10% to -48px, 0)`, `opacity-0`).
- `'after'`: A subsequent slide positioned below the viewport (`translate3d(0, 10% to 48px, 0)`, `opacity-0`).

### 3.3 Timing & Delays
All transitions use the luxury cubic bezier `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`:
- **Background Plane**: $1800\text{ms}$ duration
- **Midground Plane**: $1600\text{ms}$ duration
- **Foreground Plane**: $1450\text{ms}$ duration
- **Per-Element Stagger**:
  - `[data-stagger="1"]`: $200\text{ms}$ delay
  - `[data-stagger="2"]`: $420\text{ms}$ delay
  - `[data-stagger="3"]`: $640\text{ms}$ delay
  - `[data-stagger="4"]`: $860\text{ms}$ delay
  - `[data-stagger="5"]`: $1080\text{ms}$ delay

---

## 4. How to Extend the Deck

### Adding a New Slide
1. Open `src/content.ts` and append a new `SlideMeta` entry to `SLIDES`:
   ```ts
   { id: 'new-section', number: '14', eyebrow: '08 / NEW HORIZONS', theme: 'dark' }
   ```
2. Open `src/components/Slides.tsx` and add a new `ParallaxSlide`:
   ```tsx
   <ParallaxSlide
     meta={SLIDES[13]}
     state={stateOf(13)}
     bg={<img src="..." className="size-full object-cover" />}
   >
     <div className="max-w-3xl">
       <h2 data-stagger="1" className="font-sans text-display font-light">New Headline</h2>
       <p data-stagger="2" className="text-body text-pure/80">Supporting details...</p>
     </div>
   </ParallaxSlide>
   ```
3. Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` to verify strict compilation.
